title: 2026-10-03 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：GPU-Initiated Communication: Dissecting Down to the Bone (Koç University, GPU 发起通信的瓶颈常出在库的队列与完成域管理，而非投递本身；共享)、MegaFlux: Skew-Resilient MoE Megakernels via Pipelined Expert Replication (NVIDIA, MoE megakernel 的墙钟时间由最忙的 GPU 决定，用流)、MoE-CORE: Coordinated Expert Offloading and Residency for Memory-Constrained MoE Inference (Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 显存受限设备跑 MoE 的关键是把「谁驻留、何时搬」做成逐层策略，而)、Leto: Fast In-Place Recovery for LLM Training on Surviving Hardware (The University of Texas at Austin, 针对可原地恢复的硬件故障，把状态留在设备侧并用影子训练器预置，比 c)、AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines (KAIST, 编码 agent 反复重现代码与日志，把这些历史文本按 agent )、EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction (EPFL, KV 剪枝的重要性分数不必额外算——prefill 已经算过，只重建)、Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving (HKUST, 扩散 LLM 的一次前向可解掩多个 token，代价必须用「块 × )、Exploiting the Interplay of Compute- and Memory-Bound kernels in MPI Applications (NHR@FAU (Erlangen), 在计算受限与内存受限 kernel 交替的负载里，通信停顿反而缓解带)、Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining (机构未标注, FP4 预训练要么把 scale 与 layout 融进计算路径，要)、FastCI: Efficient GPU-Intensive CI for LLM Training Frameworks (ByteDance, 训练框架的 GPU 密集型 CI 可以用运行时证据做测试选择与剪枝，)

highlights.name: GPU-Initiated Communication: Dissecting Down to the Bone
highlights.note: 首次把 GPU–NIC 提交路径逐环节拆开，量化库实现相对最小路径最多 4.6μs 的额外发出开销

highlights.name: MegaFlux: Skew-Resilient MoE Megakernels via Pipelined Expert Replication
highlights.note: 把专家复制变成运行时决策并流水化，8×B200 前向/反向 1.45×/1.28× 加速

highlights.name: MoE-CORE: Coordinated Expert Offloading and Residency
highlights.note: 显存受限 MoE 推理的专家驻留调度，TPOT 从约 1269ms 压到 38–44.8ms
